headline: Aequs Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of order from Office of the Regional Director, South Western Region in respect of rejection of the Scheme of Amalgamation between Aequs Limited (Transferee…
detail: General Updates - Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of order from Office of the Regional Director, South Western Region in respect of rejection of the Scheme of Amalgamation between Aequs Limited (Transferee Company) and AeroStructures Manufacturing India Private Limited, Aequs Engineered Plastics Private Limited and Aequs Force Consumer Products Private Limited ( Transferor Companies ) and their respective members and creditors under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013

sources.name: NSE filing - Aequs Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
